admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Org administration tools
admin.bulkClearDescription: Permanently removes matching material stacks (and, for a game wipe, items) from the org. This cannot be undone.
admin.memberIdHelp: Leave empty to clear across all members

admin.everythingHelp: After a server wipe: removes every material and item stack of every org member, including private stashes. Blueprints, locations and refinery orders are kept.
admin.clearedCounts: Cleared {{materials}} material stacks and {{items}} item stacks.
